result: Because ReLU networks are invariant to rescaling one layer by α and the next by 1/α, any minimum has observationally equivalent minima that are arbitrarily sharp (or have infinitely large flat regions), so common flatness measures cannot by themselves explain generalization.
result_plain: Rescaling symmetries of ReLU nets make any minimum arbitrarily sharp without changing the function; sharpness alone cannot explain generalization.
